cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Test the Story First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to repeat the explanation, ask the dangerous question, or test the risky step before you commit.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Ask Dad why our holiday account's empty. I'll wait by the kitchen door.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Come with me. You booked the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Ask whether he's angry about the price first. If he isn't, I'll come in.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll ask, but I'm calling you in if he wants the flight receipt.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Ask whether he wants the total or the breakdown before you call me. The seat upgrades need a longer explanation.

cardFidelity.evidence: A3/A5 specify questions before joining Dad but professional labeling is doing most of the Stance work.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 asks A to come because A booked; A3 asks for price reaction; B4 receipt condition causes A5 distinction between total and breakdown.

relationship.evidence: B2 refuses solitary responsibility and B4 sets a threshold for calling A, giving B practical agency.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4 receipt request to delay A's entry until a finer test of the question.

specificity.evidence: A1 empty holiday account and B2 booked flights make family financial tension legible.

brevityWit.evidence: A3 standard-again phrase adds no information to A's actual condition for entering the kitchen.
